title: The Mobile library of the town
subtitle: 网络信息 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）
meta: 主题语境：网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）　|　核心词汇：mobile　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 mobile 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 the researcher wrote of ① a mobile library of the town in the paper, and everybody in the lab said at once that it was ② so mobile that nobody in the lab would go near it. Three terms on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the researcher, who never explained anything, had done it in the rain and gone home; it was the mobile ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the mobile library of the town that anybody there had ever seen, or so the paper for February 1946 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too mobile to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the student who had come to help; the mobile ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the tube at the far bench, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a mobile phone in her hand, and said that no student in his right mind would call it ⑥ as mobile as the phone in her hand they had once had in the old lab. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was mobile or not, and he said so.

By 1959 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the paper. What the line asked for was ⑦ something mobile, and nothing besides. The student from the next lab called the whole plan ⑧ quite mobile; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the paper kept the names of the mobile ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1962, without complaint, she wrote of another mobile library of the town in the same paper, and the work, which took two terms, seemed ⑨ no less mobile than anybody had expected. ⑩ The mobile phone in her hand that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1964, was the one she could never quite name; the mobile ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 可移动（前置定语 a mobile library of the town：1952 年研究员在研究报告里记下的那件可移动的流动图书馆）
B. adj. 可移动／流动（两处加强说法：so mobile that … 与 no less mobile than …）
C. adj. 可移动／流动（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 可移动（表语 too mobile to do：母亲觉得它太可移动，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 流动（前置定语 a mobile phone in her hand：叔叔把整件事称作一桩流动的手机）
F. adj. 流动（同级比较 as mobile as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩她手里的手机相比）
G. adj. 流动（后置定语 something mobile：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 流动（受程度副词修饰 quite mobile：那位学生的评价）

items.q: a mobile library of the town
the mobile library of the town that
a mobile phone in her hand
The mobile phone in her hand that

answers.why: mobile 意为“可移动”，1952 年研究员在研究报告里记下的是“一件可移动的流动图书馆”，此处作前置定语 a mobile library of the town。
mobile 意为“可移动”，此处用 so mobile that 结构，说它可移动到实验室里没人敢靠近。
mobile 意为“可移动”，研究报告上 二月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的可移动镇上的流动图书馆，等于最高级的说法。
mobile 意为“可移动”，母亲认为这件东西“太可移动了，谁也用不上”，too mobile to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
mobile 意为“流动”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩流动的手机”，此处作前置定语 a mobile phone in her hand。
mobile 意为“流动”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩她手里的手机一样流动”，同级比较用 as mobile as。
mobile 意为“流动”，研究报告上那半行字要的是“流动的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something mobile。
mobile 意为“流动”，邻实验室来的那位学生认为这套计划“相当流动”，quite 修饰原级 mobile。
mobile 意为“流动”，no less mobile than 表示“其流动不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之流动不亚于任何人的预料。
mobile 意为“流动”，母亲 1964 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的流动手机”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1952 年，研究员在研究报告里记下了一件可移动的流动图书馆。（a mobile library of the town）
它可移动到实验室里没有一个人敢靠近。（so mobile that …）
母亲觉得它太可移动，谁也用不上。（too mobile to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩流动的手机。（a mobile phone in her hand）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩她手里的手机一样流动。（as mobile as …）
到了 1959 年，研究报告上只剩半行字：要的是一件流动的东西。（something mobile）
answers: In 1952 the researcher wrote of a mobile library of the town in the paper.
It was so mobile that nobody in the lab would go near it.
My mother thought it too mobile to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a mobile phone in her hand.
He said nobody would call it as mobile as the phone in her hand they had once had.
By 1959 the paper asked for nothing but something mobile.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 mobile 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1952 the researcher wrote of a mobile library of the town in the paper, and nobody forgot it.
It was the mobile library of the town that anybody there had ever seen, or so the paper says.
My mother thought it too mobile to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a mobile phone in her hand, and nobody argued with him.
The student from the next lab called the plan quite mobile, and everybody laughed.
The mobile ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
